sessions.title: Teacup Weather Window Club
sessions.sessionFit: 20-minute adult-led after-school club opener for a small table that needs one setting detail and one gentle sentence finish.
sessions.directorSetup: Print one page per writer, place pencils and two pretend weather clue cards on the table, and keep the activity at an indoor writing station.
sessions.kidDirection: Look through the teacup weather window, choose one sky clue, and write what the tiny helper notices next.
sessions.facilitatorPrompt: Ask the table which clue is easiest to picture, then model one short sentence that starts with because.

pageSections.heading: Weather Window
lines: The teacup window shows a sky clue: ____________________.
The weather card on the sill says ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Town Helper
lines: The helper carries a tiny supply of ____________________.
The helper checks the cup-handle bridge for ____________________.
The kind plan for the town is ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Club Sentence
lines: First, the sky clue changes near ____________________.

sessions.clubShareLine: Club share line: One weather clue I can read to the table is ____________________.
sessions.wrapUpLine: Wrap-up line: The detail that made my teacup scene clearer was ____________________.
sessions.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle one line to finish later: ____________________.
sessions.takeHomePromptLine: Take-home prompt: Add one weather clues detail for this club story: ____________________.

sessions.title: Spoon Ferry Harbor Note
sessions.sessionFit: 22-minute adult-led after-school club page for a calm table after snack, with one object choice and one short harbor note.
sessions.directorSetup: Print the harbor page, set out pencils and paper spoon markers, and place a simple lunchbox map in the center of the table.
sessions.kidDirection: Send the paper spoon ferry across the lunchbox harbor, choose what it carries, and write a clear note for the dock crew.
sessions.facilitatorPrompt: Ask writers to name one pretend harbor object before they decide what the ferry carries.

sessions.wrapUpLine: Wrap-up line: The object that helped my setting was ____________________.
sessions.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the ferry path, then finish this clue: ____________________.
sessions.takeHomePromptLine: Take-home prompt: Add one setting objects detail for this club story: ____________________.

sessions.title: Pocket Park Notice Table
sessions.sessionFit: 20-minute adult-led after-school club table for writers who can invent one notice and explain why it helps a tiny park.
sessions.directorSetup: Print one notice page per writer, set out pencils and three blank paper strips, and keep all notices fictional.
sessions.kidDirection: Invent a pocket park notice, choose the clearest reason, and write what the park helper does next.
sessions.facilitatorPrompt: Prompt the group to use invented park details, then help each writer finish one because sentence.

sessions.takeHomePromptLine: Take-home prompt: Add one message and reason detail for this club story: ____________________.

sessions.title: Acorn Errand Desk
sessions.sessionFit: 22-minute adult-led after-school club activity for a table that needs first, next, and last story steps.
sessions.directorSetup: Print the errand desk page, set out pencils and three paper leaf slips, and keep the route on the table map.
sessions.kidDirection: Sort three friendly errand slips, choose a helpful order, and write the desk note that explains the route.
sessions.facilitatorPrompt: Ask which errand should come first and what clue makes the order easier to follow.

sessions.title: Button Bakery Map Fix
sessions.sessionFit: 24-minute adult-led after-school club session for a table ready to use direction words and specific bakery details.
sessions.directorSetup: Print one bakery map page per writer, set out pencils and crumb-path paper strips, and sketch a simple tabletop route.
sessions.kidDirection: Choose a bakery clue, add a direction word, and help the button baker fix the mixed-up map.
sessions.facilitatorPrompt: Invite writers to replace vague clues with objects the whole table can picture.

sessions.title: Penny Path Compass Card
sessions.sessionFit: 22-minute adult-led after-school club page for a tabletop route activity with one compass clue and one clear direction card.
sessions.directorSetup: Print one compass page per writer, place a pretend penny compass card on each table, and keep the route on paper.
sessions.kidDirection: Spin the pretend compass, choose a path clue, and write three directions for the shop helper.
sessions.facilitatorPrompt: Ask each writer to include one direction word and one detail a reader could picture.
